task: hard cases in the python_general cluster requiring retry-on-failure
mistake: Re-emitting the same logic with cosmetic tweaks instead of reading the expected-vs-actual diff.
solution: On a python_general task, when the first attempt fails the validator, re-read the validator feedback (expected vs. actual diff) and identify the specific mismatch — most common shapes are float formatting (`round()` vs. f-string), tie-break ordering, off-by-one bounds, and edge cases on empty / missing rows.
